newsitem.title: USA: FDA approves Kensey Nash Angio-Seal.
newsitem.headline: FDA approves Kensey Nash Angio-Seal.

text.p: Kensey Nash Corp said Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had granted marketing approval for the company's primary product, the 8 French ("8F") size Angio-Seal device.
The Angio-Seal uses both a mechanical and a biochemical seal to close arterial punctures following diagnostic and certain therapeutic cardiovascular catheterization procedures.
Physicians seal puncture sites within minutes as compared to the current time of about 20 minutes of manual pressure, according to the company.
In the United States the 8F Angio-Seal is for use in sealing arterial punctures following balloon angioplasty and diagnostic angiography procedures.
The product will be manufactured on a commercial scale and marketed by American Home Products Corp.
Kensey Nash will receive a $1 million milestone payment from AHP, which will be recognized in the company's first fiscal quarter ended September 30, Kensey Nash said.
